messages:
mina_pm: Quick sync: we're finalizing the GA acceptance checklist for Predict v2. Need short confirmation on SLA table, docs scope (hosted/dedicated/private), minimal runbooks, and pricing SKUs. Can owners call out blockers by EOD?

 tom_eng: From infra: we can reliably meet proposed p95 for small/med models on hosted. p99 for large models still shows spikes due to cold-starts. We'll provide mitigation (warm pools + quantized fallbacks) but mark p99 as informational for GA.

 ada_docs: Docs plan: one public SLA blurb, a short migration checklist, and per-deployment quickstarts. Need final SLA numbers + CLI flags for cache TTL and batching to finish examples. PR by 3pm.

 ravi_sre: Runbooks: need automated throttling control in console or we document a manual throttle procedure. Also require explicit fallback play (model variant, region failover) and weekend on-call for first 2 weeks post-GA.

 lucy_fin: Pricing: propose two SKUs at GA (Hosted metered, Reserved capacity). Want model-class + token-length buckets for pricing clarity. I'll draft numbers once SLA buckets confirmed.

 infra_bot: Reminder: UI deploy freeze 2024-11-01 - any console controls must land before freeze.

 mina_pm: Actions: @tom_eng freeze SLA table & sample fallback config; @ada_docs prepare SLA blurb PR; @ravi_sre draft runbook and rota; @lucy_fin draft SKU mapping. If no blockers, we'll take to exec for signoff tomorrow.
